knownOutcomes.description: The authenticated session does not have the teller role required to open a sub-account. Manifests two ways depending on how far the flow got: the member-detail page never renders the "Open Sub-Account" link for a non-teller session (caught first, since step-4 tries to click that link), or -- if the route were reached directly -- the server-side route handler denies it explicitly. Both candidates are checked, first match wins, since either is conclusive evidence of the same underlying condition.

locator.reason: UI-level signal: this replaces the Open Sub-Account link on the member detail page for non-teller sessions, so it's what a replay actually hits first -- found by testing a readonly-role replay and seeing it hard-fail at step-4 instead of hitting the route-level denial text below.

locator.text: Permission denied: your role does not permit this action.
locator.reason: Route-level signal: exact banner text rendered by the role-gated sub-account route itself, for a session that reached it directly (e.g. a capability whose flow starts past the member-detail page).

outcome.message: The current session's role does not permit opening a sub-account.
